step1_summary.chief_complaint: Breathing difficulties after a wasp sting.

symptoms.severity: Moderate (noted as shallow breath and tightness)

step1_summary.medications/allergies: No regular medications; allergic to penicillin.
step1_summary.vital_signs/exam_findings: Tightness in chest, tingling sensation in lips, slight blotching on the skin.

I: Anaphylaxis: Rationale - Patient experienced breathing difficulties and lip tingling after a wasp sting, suggesting a potential allergic reaction.
Allergic Reaction: Rationale - Symptoms of tightness in the chest and skin blotching may indicate an allergic response.
